about:
HB Molding was founded in 1998 on the south side of Louisville before relocating to a 78,000-square-foot facility in Jeffersontown, Kentucky, on the city's east side with direct access to major north-south interstates. The company is owned by Mark Hallam and began as a custom injection molder focused on quick reaction to customer demands.

Today HB Molding operates 37 injection molding presses ranging from 120 to 500 tons with shot capacities of 4 to 60 ounces. The plant runs five days a week, 24 hours a day, with weekend availability for demand spikes. Beyond molding, the shop provides ultrasonic welding, hot stamping, pad printing, assembly, tool building, and in-house 3D scanning. The operation is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

The molder serves as both a Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier to a range of industries, with a documented relationship with GE Appliance, which recognized HB Molding with a 2017 Supplier Quality Performance Award and a 2018 Silent Warrior award. Most customers are within a 200-mile radius of Louisville.

Hallam attributes the company's growth to its ability to react quickly to customer needs and opportunities. The quality team establishes control plans to match or exceed project requirements, emphasizing on-time delivery and attention to detail.
